pages.scan: Opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-01.png with Read. It loaded: a 3-panel page with no numbers (one full-width panel on top, two panels below). I opened it before reading any script, source or workflow.json.
pages.observation: How I read it: P1 (top, full width): caption at top-left 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' A small face box for Ananya sits just below and right of the caption. No dialogue. P2 (lower left, tall): balloon at upper left 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' then a lower balloon to the right 'I wish everything were easier to manage!'. Both tails point to Meera's face box. Left-high then right-low reads naturally and there is no ambiguity. P3 (lower right, tall): 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' with a tail to Ananya at the right. A small Meera face box sits lower left and stays silent. Issues: (1) The first balloon in P2 has a long tail that ends at the top-left corner of Meera's face box, not near her mouth. It is fine for this stage, but check it once the art exists. (2) The caption names Ananya, but nothing tells us who Meera is (her name or role, e.g. staff or receptionist). A first reader learns her role only from the art. (3) P2 and P3 have a lot of empty space below the faces. That is fine for art, but the faces sit high and small. (4) Nothing covers a face. The question and answer flow (complaint, then Ananya's reassurance) is clear.
